As she searches for answers alongside her father Reed (David Cubitt) and husband Dan (Hamza Haq), Elizabeth uncovers a tangled web of family betrayal and long-buried secrets.  As she closes in on the truth, Elizabeth must separate fact from manipulation and fight to survive before history repeats itself.

title: Hitler’s Games: Berlin 1936 in Colour
overview: In 1931, Germany was awarded the Olympic Games in the hope this would draw them into the international community and world peace would be promoted through sport.  For two weeks in August 1936 cameras captured the world’s greatest sporting spectacle, including the Gold Medal triumphs of record-breaking sprinter Jesse Owens. The Berlin Olympics were groundbreaking – many innovations introduced in 1936 such as television coverage and the torch relay became part of every subsequent Games.  Hitler’s Games in Colour tells the story of the remarkable amateurs who excelled, but also how Hitler used the Games as propaganda for his brutal regime, to show the Nazis as benign and their military ambitions as modest. Using black and white archive, transformed by cutting-edge restoration and colourisation, this is the story of 16 days that fooled the world…

title: Manhunt

Somewhere in the Great Rift Valley stands a small, forgotten, and seemingly useless military base. When the Chinese government offers the state of Israel an enormous sum of cash to lay the path of their new Silk Road through it, all that seems to be done is to shut this base down. overview: Tiana and her family seek refuge in Mateo and Tomas' village, but the pollution they are fleeing from will catch them here, too.

Their bond sparks laughter, friendship, and the creation of the “Little Tree Defense Squad,” where four children protect their secret green haven. But when humans threaten to destroy the tree, Little Tree must return to the forest. For the first time, Chubby steps forward, determined to find his friend and protect the world they love with his own courage.

To survive the winter and save her sister, Tamara must deliver six letters and prove her fitness for the job, only to be hired as a postman.

A story of unexpected encounters.

Olmo, in the throes of selfish adolescence, would much rather hang out with his best friend Miguel and try to impress his beautiful next-door neighbor Nina than take care of his dad. And when Nina finally invites him to a party on the day that he’s been left alone with his dad, Olmo will do whatever he can to get out of his duties, embarking on a journey of mischief and chaos. In his desperate attempt to escape his home life, he will come to realize that the place of his deepest pain is also where he will find solace: with his family.

Di Shao, a genius young man aspiring to become "Chang'an's Number One Detective," possesses exceptional crime-solving skills and a sharp tongue; while Asa, a rookie wolf demon constable, is formidable in martial arts yet kind-hearted. A bizarre murder case forces these two adversaries to team up, embarking on a hilarious and bickering detective journey. As clues point to the heart of the city, can this unreliable duo protect the joyful daily life of this fantastical city? And what earth-shattering secret lies hidden behind the bustling and prosperous Chang'an?

title: THE RIBBON HERO
overview: The story of Sapphire as she overcomes loss and trauma to protect those she holds dear.

title: Ghost of Ueno

Satsuki works part-time at an NGO near Ueno Park, indifferent to her job and the faces of those seeking help, until she stumbles upon the diary of a deceased homeless man. Toshi, a fellow drifter in the park, tells her that her encounter with the man’s ghost is no accident. Guided by the diary, they embark on a journey into the past to uncover the man’s identity, which is deeply intertwined with Ueno’s post-war history. Along the way, they meet those whose lives the ghost touched, each revealing a story of a man who willingly cut ties with his family. Satsuki’s dreams and memories lead her astray, uncovering a bitter truth. Her search for answers about the vanished finds resolution in Toshi, who waits for the third reincarnation of his late wife.

overview: In 1988, Abdul Ahad Momand became Afghanistan's first and only astronaut. From orbit, he called his mother, making Pashto the fourth language spoken in space. Below him, his nation was collapsing.

title: Hollow Girls
overview: On the night of June 2, 2023, a shocking crime shattered a quiet community. Six teenage girls lured one of their classmates into a deadly trap. Fueled by jealousy and a twisted desire for revenge, they set into motion a plan that would end in kidnapping, torture, and murder.

title: The Sick Mind of EDP445
overview: New evidence emerges on the internet’s most notorious villain. An unprecedented documentary diving into the downfall and perverse mindset and crimes of former YouTuber EDP445.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 14
overview: The fourteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 9, 2026, at G Messe Gunma in Takasaki, Gunma, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Shingo Takagi and Yuto-Ice.

title: I Rarely Wake Up Dreaming
overview: The love of Olya and Oleh, a young queer Ukrainian couple, is put to the test when one partner's gender transition collides with Russia's full-scale invasion.

title: House of Death
overview: At night, a boy is terrorized by a dark latex figure.

title: Another Day in the Metal Box
overview: When a Ukrainian factory worker finds a mysterious object hidden in an abandoned workshop, he must choose between the safety of the life he knows and the dream he has never dared to pursue.

title: Digby & Camille
overview: In this tender, intimate and humorous documentary, experience the adventures and frustrations of a pair of inseparable lovers as they dream of building a life together

title: Brave New Love
overview: Kate lives happily with her husband and their daughter while simultaneously sharing a romantic relationship with another man. After years of secrecy, the fragile balance of her double life begins to unravel.

title: Sixteen Moments of My Life
overview: Ingrid Caven sings about 16 moments from her life in a unique concert at the Théâtre des Bouffes du Nord in Paris.

title: Hearing
overview: Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships.

title: The Wanderers
overview: 1957. As a farewell for her lover Teresa, Zurda and her friends go on one of their usual weekend camp-outs in the middle of the woods. A time stolen for rest, playfulness and illicit pleasures, away from the watchful eye of Franco’s dictatorship.

title: Her Silence
overview: An international student hosts her visiting parents in her Sydney flat, and spends two fraught days wrestling with her mother’s unspoken social expectations and apprehensions about the life her daughter has chosen to build in Australia. This finely wrought, elegantly shot family drama expresses the complex emotions of intergenerational diaspora through closely observed everyday moments.

title: Live Crickets
overview: Cass throws an impromptu funeral for her oldest friend, two weeks after her boyfriend dumped her and moved out. As Cass walks through the sea of people she thought might be her friends, we watch her realize just how alone she truly is.

title: Epitaph
overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: Rebel Flowers
overview: A nun is forced to confront her own past and make a decision destined to change the course of her life forever. When her best friend asks her help, faith, guilt, and friendship collide.

title: Wandering Trees
overview: Piero and his son Giuliano live alone, on the edge of town, in a farmhouse filled with injured animals they collect and care for. The Nonne, local notables, want to drive them out because they live like vagrants. During a snowfall, Piero disappears and the animals are killed. Giuliano has no choice but to search for his father.

title: Gherking
overview: The dictator's shouts are broadcast over the radio to every corner of the country. A fire is flickering in the stove, and an old woman makes provisions for the approaching winter.

title: Soft Gaze
overview: Lonely police officer Georgie becomes fascinated by a queer couple she observes at the beach, recognising their soft intimacy as something missing from her own emotionally arid heterosexual relationship. Time slows eerily and soothing touches and sounds grow sinister as her fixation becomes charged with hungry sensuality.

title: Despite the Night
overview: Months after a volcanic eruption, a cloud of ash still looms overhead, plunging much of northern Australia into a perpetual night. As a city empties, days bleed into nights, seasons vanish, and time begins to rot. Inside a quiet apartment, two brothers face the slow death of their world, and a faster one inside their home.

title: September Afternoon
overview: A couple refuses to accept that summer is over. One last time, they head to the coast, to be together between sand dunes and sea water.

title: The Bigfoot Experiment
overview: A group of vloggers investigate an abandoned research facility, where long-buried secrets transform their search into a desperate fight for survival.

title: Nine on the Line
overview: When a new player appears on the horizon, the old order in the pool club begins to fall apart and the real game is played far beyond the table.

title: Tomb of Dreams
overview: Louis and Lénore have sought refuge in a lonely house by the sea. As in a dream, zombies appear, wandering at nightfall. Do they really exist?

title: Nimrods
overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: Piluk
overview: Born from a single feather, young Piluk walks on, just as her mother did before her. Throughout her journey, she offers feathers from her thinning wings to passersby and wounded animals. From the raw landscapes of the tundra to a city of concrete, will she still be able to hear the breath of the wind that witnessed her birth?

title: The Cuts
overview: Theatre faculty spar over outlandish financial schemes to keep their department afloat. The arts are worth saving - but can these bozos do it?

title: Summer Meadow
overview: Hana works as an apprentice shepherdess, leading an isolated life in the Alps, far from the hustle and bustle of the world and the echoes of her native Lebanon. The arrival of Lisa, who has been sent to help her with the animals, forces her out of her solitude and invites her to reconnect with her own story.

title: Paradeisa
overview: Struggling to keep their family together, Lou helps her broke artist father fake his own death to boost the value of his work.

title: I Have Laughed Again
overview: Lan, a stoic counselor, masks her soul's fractures with professional restraint until she meets Zhen-Zhen. The rebellious dropout's fragmented talk of a fatal car accident strikes a terrifying chord—it is the same tragedy that claimed Lan's lover. What begins as therapy spirals into a dangerous obsession.

title: The Riverbank
overview: Izaquiel works as a cleaner in Recife, a Brazilian city intertwined with rivers and mangroves. At night, he dangerously ventures out in search of secret encounters in the mangrove forest. His world shifts when he crosses paths with Jeremias, an intriguing and magnetic fisherman.

title: In Dreams When You Can't Sleep at Night
overview: 15 years ago, Ariel completed my military service in the Israeli army's spokesperson unit. Today, based on real texts I found during my time there, I open up a dialogue with a young Israeli sniper.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 15
overview: The fifteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 11, 2026, at Nisho Highway Arena in Tsu, Mie, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Gabe Kidd and Yuya Uemura.

title: Typhoon Mambo
overview: Rusmee keeps interacting with Chalerm, her dead husband, in the form of an AI chatbot.

title: BAKMA
overview: In Tunisia, Commissioner Ali and Khaled investigate the ritualistic murder of a young woman.

title: The Hollywood Blacklist: The Survivors Tell Their Stories
overview: Featuring previously unseen footage from an early-1980s Los Angeles party honouring the blacklistees. (Note: this is an expanded version of footage previously used in "La dernière fête des blacklistés", 2025)

title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
overview: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

title: Sunny Dancer
overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

title: Sad Girlz
overview: La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers in their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in her best friend has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the two are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet about it, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before.

title: Tear Gas
overview: 16-year-old Elene and her war-scarred family are drawn into a mass protest in Tbilisi that transforms the streets into a battleground for freedom, forcing them to confront the fractures already threatening to tear them apart.

title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS
overview: This celebrates the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

title: Sacrifice
overview: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

title: Fast
overview: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

title: Fire Flower
overview: Yoko Hayasuke's journal is set in the wake of the tsunami and nuclear disaster after the Tōhoku earthquake. Something happened yet life goes on: Tokyo continues to expand, new soil replaces irradiated land.

title: O Jacaré
overview: Reboleira, a suburb of Lisbon. The loot from a robbery has mysteriously vanished. Within the neighborhood cordoned off by the police, everyone dreams of getting their hands on it

title: Mu-Ki-Ra
overview: When her brother is kidnapped by Mu-Ki-Ra, Cleo ventures into a monster-plagued jungle with unlikely allies.

title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 16
overview: The sixteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 12, 2026, at Act City Hamamatsu in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Shingo Takagi and SANADA.

title: Un grand raccourci
overview: When their family restaurant is on the verge of closing, two cousins release rats in an attempt to set themselves up as pest control experts. That same summer, two young women rig the local beauty contest to promote their jewelry. Caught up in their chaotic schemes, these four resourceful young people searching for a better future eventually cross paths.

title: Steckerlfischfiasko
overview: Franz Eberhofer and Rudi Birkenberger's next case takes them to Niederkaltenkirchen's new golf course. The two detectives promptly get caught up in a full-blown family feud between two folk festival clans.

title: The Other Mahmoud
overview: It follows two contradictory young men with the same name, which puts them in unexpected, strange and funny situations at the same time.

title: A Turkish case
overview: Mathieu distanced himself from his Turkish community to climb the social ladder. A determined lawyer, he works hard to become a partner at an influential Parisian law firm. When a young Turkish man in a precarious situation who needs help bursts into his life, Mathieu is drawn into a corruption scandal that threatens to destroy everything he has built.

title: Last Chance to Evacuate Earth
overview: A casual kidnapping takes Crystal to rural Victoria with her estranged best friend. Though Chester promises a pleasant getaway, the mystery of his unexplained two-year absence - and a looming cosmic event threaten to overshadow their journey.

title: Mama
overview: In a quest to terminate the pregnancy, a young woman faces her first grown-up experience.

title: Down the Arm of God
overview: A young pastor goes through a harsh winter in a small Texas town, where his mission to help the homeless is faced with resistance by his congregation, exposing deep-seated prejudice and systemic failures.

title: The First Flower
overview: One intense day in the life of Siki as they navigate desire, violence, and transformation.

title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

title: The End of Oak Street
overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
overview: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

title: Batwara 1947
overview: The story of an elderly Muslim woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Hindu refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

title: Perumahan Laddaland
overview: To provide a better life for his wife and children, Tomy takes out a mortgage to buy his dream home. This happiness doesn't last long. Since moving into the new housing complex, his family has been terrorized by various unnatural occurrences. Mysterious whispers, terrifying apparitions, and dark secrets lurking within the complex threaten their safety.

title: Power Trip
overview: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

title: Honestino
overview: Arrested five times for his activism, student leader Honestino Guimarães was kidnapped in 1973 at the age of 26 and is one of the hundreds of people who disappeared during the Brazilian military dictatorship.

title: Drift
overview: Over the course of a single night, a convoy of cars carries intimate conversations on the representation of Black bodies in France.

title: Magic Atlas
overview: A magician arrives in the reclusive coal empire of Luocha, triggering widespread panic in a society already simmering beneath a fragile peace.

title: Finding Connection
overview: In a world where digital distance reshapes human bonds, genuine closeness has become a fragile treasure. Finding Connection follows those yearning for trust and emotional intimacy, only to discover an unexpected anchor in the algorithms of AI. The deeply personal exchanges between humans and machines give rise to questions that echo long after the credits roll. The film’s perspective remains refreshingly unbiased, inviting reflection rather than judgment.

title: Kolobok
overview: Kolobok decides to change his fate and unwittingly becomes the partner of the humble baker Tikhon.

title: Yugly
overview: Yugly, an irresistibly ugly dog, is determined to compete in the World's Best Dog Show, rallied by a bunch of flamboyant strays.

title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

title: Buddies and the Heir
overview: Following the death of a hotelier in Punta del Este, Uruguay, an unexpected inheritance dispute begins. Stallone, an actor with Down syndrome, believes he is the rightful heir to the hotel. On the other side is Magrelo, a young autistic man who was raised as an adopted son by the deceased. Without waiting for the reading of the will, Stallone decides to reunite his old friends with Down syndrome from the institute where they lived in Brazil to spend a week's vacation at the hotel.

title: Already Happened
overview: Hao Zhou confronts their younger self's compromised imagination, inviting the ghost of their youth to reconsider what lies ahead.

title: Fogaréu
overview: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. She returns to the home of her wealthy uncle, after the death of her adoptive mother, in order to implode the certainties and to reveal the painful truth about its origin.

title: Ketok Mejik
overview: Ben, a grandson who is 'forced' to inherit his grandfather's "Ketok Magic" workshop. However, this inheritance comes with a series of problems that will confuse the entire village!

title: In My Mother's Mirror
overview: When successful archaeologist Ursula Scheuer makes a sensational discovery of a body during a bog excavation, her demented mother suddenly dies. Unexpectedly, a childhood trauma breaks out for Ursula. The appearance of her new assistant Mel is also puzzling: she seems to know Ursula’s past very well. Ursula is increasingly drawn into a mysterious web of fantasies and deceptions and must finally free herself from it.

title: This, That, and Everything in Between
overview: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

title: Nowhere to Lay My Eyes
overview: With her brother, Sang-hee visits her mother on Jeju Island. It’s been 10 years. Her mother's restaurant has become a hit. Her stepfather is making a film about a "grass tomb". His daughter has just started painting. Previously unknown facts, needless advice, and cheap compliments are passed back and forth. On the morning of her departure, the other family members watch one of Sang-hee’s films.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 17
overview: The seventeenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 13, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Yuya Uemura and OSKAR.

title: Jebediah: Are We OK?
overview: This is the story of a band that grew up but never grew apart. Jebediah's thirty-year journey is a celebration of friendship, creativity, and staying connected against the odds.

title: A Sweet Day
overview: When a young woman gets the chance to have a conjugal meeting with her imprisoned husband after a long time,  ​she decides to re-experience a romantic time in the apathetic and harsh atmosphere of the prison.

title: Far From the Trees
overview: Adela, a Mexican sound artist, travels from the jungle to the Peruvian Andes alongside Lucho, a guide and translator. Following the legacy of her grandfather, a Republican exiled in Mexico, she weaves a sound map of endangered languages. When the fear of death breaks in, reality fractures.

title: The Crystal Planet
overview: 11-year-old Rea has recently moved to a distant planet in an outer-space colony where she discovers a mysterious animal cub while her father works in a factory that builds robotic creatures. With the help of her new friend Andy, she must protect the real cub from the factory’s ruthless owner, who intends to turn it into a robotic prototype.

title: Rio de Clarice
overview: Film based on five short stories by Clarice Lispector (“A Bela e a Fera”, “Amor”, “Feliz Aniversário”, “Preciosidade” e “Mal-estar de um Anjo”).

title: Concrete Land
overview: An intimate story of three generations of a Palestinian Bedouin family in Jordan.

title: Vishwanath & Sons
overview: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that they must come to terms with.

title: Camp Rock 3
overview: When Connect 3 loses their opening act for a major reunion tour, they return to their beloved Camp Rock to discover the next big thing. As campers vie for the chance to open for their favorite band, tensions rise and friendships are tested - leading to unexpected alliances, revelations, and romances.

title: The Rivals of Amziah King
overview: Amziah King, beekeeper, musician, and anchor of his community, reunites with former foster daughter Kateri after many years apart, and fends off threats to his honey business.

title: The Brink of War
overview: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

title: Elijah Peel
overview: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

title: The Wrong Girls
overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: Awarapan 2
overview: 19 years later, Shivam is back. A man haunted by grief and loss, searching for a purpose for his life.

title: Surplace
overview: On prom night, graduate Inga discovers that her boyfriend Kęstas is secretly helping a young stranger. As the night unfolds, the youth begins to sense that while they’re celebrating new beginnings, someone is searching for their own path into the future.

title: Abandoned
overview: Chasing a viral video to save their channel and friendship, two urban explorers break into a derelict facility scarred by sinister experiments. Trapped among its secrets, they enter a nightmare where history manifests as evil.

title: Mad Rush
overview: Madisha’s morning couldn’t get any worse: a rootless Gen Z already struggling to find her purpose in life, she’s just learned that her housemate is ditching her and is still reeling from having lost her most recent job under cloudy circumstances. So when she gets a call advising her of fraudulent activity on her bank account and urgently requesting that she withdraw all of her money in cash, Madisha is sent on a panicked odyssey through the Melbourne CBD – a pursuit that leads her to ominous alleyways, busy street corners, an alcohol-soaked house party and, perhaps, the fledgling desire to take charge of her own life.

title: Lady
overview: A lonely, narcissistic aristocrat dupes a struggling, opportunistic director into filming her every move. Her obsession with the spotlight takes a surreal turn when she starts becoming... invisible.

title: Don't Say Good Luck
overview: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until suddenly she’s living with even more drama at home than on the stage.

title: Zrugg
overview: After an attack on a farmer's livestock, an obsessive wildlife officer is sent out to hunt down and kill the problematic wolf.

title: Lajjawati
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Union County
overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

title: West/East
overview: We follow Russian inhabitants of Estonia as they travel to Russia. Their crossing of the border takes them through a geographical space marked by tensions between two ethnic groups, while the Russian-Ukrainian war reignites old fears.

title: American Doctor
overview: When three American doctors — Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian — enter Gaza to save lives, they find themselves caught between medicine and politics, risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Out There
overview: When a 16-year-old astronomy enthusiast witnesses a UFO above her sleepy Welsh seaside town, she ropes in her sceptical best mate and an unhinged ufologist to help her uncover a truth she’s not yet ready to face.

title: Summer Days
overview: Summer is promising for Juan and Gabriela, who plan to have a beach house. However, their plans are disrupted when Juan's father arrives with his new, younger girlfriend, Mónica, causing tension and a challenging coexistence.

title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
overview: For Olli, one thing is clear: his best friend Matze has obviously been brainwashed by his new girlfriend Rebecca. Her disastrous influence not only jeopardizes their friendship, but above all the trip around the world that Olli and Matze have been planning for years, down to the last detail. So there is only one solution: Rebecca must be stopped! Together with his buddy Schmitti, Olli goes on the offensive. But to everyone's surprise, Rebecca also has a few tricks up her sleeve. The battle is on.

title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
overview: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

title: I Have No Mouth, Yet I Must Scream
overview: The deceased Venezuelan awaits, uncertain of what comes next. According to the machines, the voyage to paradise starts soon. But in digital purgatory, bureaucracy and control continue.

title: The House on the Moon
overview: Chang Er, a fairy maiden, embarks on a journey to the dark side of the moon to search for her lover Ho Yi, a sun-shooting archer who vanished on his quest to save the dying sun.

title: Toxic
overview: As Portuguese rule crumbles in Goa, Raya rises through betrayal and bloodshed to claim the city’s underworld, only to learn that power always demands a price.

title: Yes, Mistress
overview: At 61, Steve leads a seemingly ordinary routine life. But behind this facade hides a much more complex universe: that of BDSM, where the body becomes a field of pleasure and exploration of submission. This anthropologically inspired documentary paints an intimate portrait of this man who, through his fantasies, seeks to redefine his relationship with the body, desire and his deep identity. By diving into his most abstract motivations, the film questions what this quest for control… and abandonment reveals.

title: Amaretti
overview: When septuagenarian Lenny's reality is devastated by the discovery of a prolonged, pernicious crime committed against her by her own son, an unexpected connection helps her to begin a journey towards re-forging her fractured identity....

title: Shutterbug
overview: A rave photographer struggles to navigate a complex power dynamic with his boss, which comes to a head at an after party in Glasgow.

title: Bubbles
overview: Justyna, an immigrant housemaid, grows close to her wealthy employer as her own living conditions worsen. Facing eviction,  she discovers something that will irreversibly change their relationship.

title: Skerry & May
overview: In the near future, May returns to a remote Scottish island for one last conversation with her lost partner, in a world drifting between memory and simulation, laying bare both grief and the limits of technology.

title: Infernal
overview: Infernal follows Azrael, a young man bound to forces beyond his control as rival powers close in around him. His journey in search of his wife is tests his loyalty and betrayal ignites a struggle that will decide the world’s fate.

title: Aussie at Heart
overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

title: Empty Heaven
overview: When a lonely Iranian dissident becomes embroiled with a local criminal mob in Canada, their bullish bidding leads to complex turns of events.

title: Anfa 8
overview: In the city of Soli, ruled by Anfa 8, where night is eternal, Horus hunts a renegade cult of solar worshippers who are desperately searching for the sun.

title: Garchaster's Cornblade
overview: A gricky star planet girl follows a casting call into the Earth oven so she can fulfill her dream of getting inside of a VHS tape... to burn and inhale herself. Donald Farmer weaves golden webs with the cryogenic cowboys while the star planet gets heavier with razzling trash carnivals. The Carpet Muckers twirling gorches but the Garbites are way too hungry for karaoke flavored peanut butter screams.

title: Neighbour
overview: As student protests sweep through a deeply divided Belgrade, a police officer recognizes the young man he is beating during a violent clash. The encounter haunts him, growing into an obsession that forces him to confront the fragile line between professional duty and personal conviction.

title: Desert Ed
overview: After the passing of his longtime teammate on the reality TV Show Battlebots, robot engineer Edward Robinson moves out to the desert, where he reflects on his career and adapts a new hermetic lifestyle.

title: Cartografía
overview: An intuitive self-portrait and esoteric geographic exploration of the filmmaker's astrocartography line of Venus and Midheaven in Los Angeles, a prominent point in her birth chart for creativity and harmony.  With each version of herself comes a distinct relationship with the city and cinema, and each version shares an unavoidable fate: the passing of her grandmother.

title: Amongst Men
overview: Relatives of Charles Byrne ‘The Irish Giant’ reckon with the legacy of a man both mythologised and misunderstood and the condition that links them still.

title: Paradise
overview: The enigmatic captain of a burning cargo ship binds together the fates of two families; one in a bustling Ghanaian city, the other in a quiet Canadian town.

title: Hidden Love
overview: Sang Zhi quietly falls for Duan Jiaxu, her older brother’s college roommate. Years later, a chance reunion allows their once-hidden feelings to resurface, gradually turning an unspoken crush into a heartfelt romance.

title: 我想留在你身边
overview: Ancient architecture restorer Jiang Nanshan falls for medical student Li Ai, only to discover that she comes from a parallel world where time flows in reverse and their timelines move in opposite directions.

title: Fools of Nature
overview: On the first night of an impromptu journey out of New York City, Malcolm and Jamie trek through New Jersey, eventually stopping to stay the night at a motel. As the night moves along, the two friends are forced to confront their relationship head-on, changing the course of their relationship forever.

title: Providence and the Guitar
overview: In a distant past, Léon and Elvira Berthelini, itinerant artists, make their living hopping from town to town. In Covarronca, harassed by the Police Commissioner, they are forced to spend the night out in the open. That’s when they meet Stubbs, a young Cambridge student, with whom they find shelter in the home of a painter at odds with his wife. In return for the hospitality, they remind their hosts that the love of art resolves the art of love. Meanwhile, an unusual curse sends them on absurd journeys into the 21st century, where the future of social security and of a rock band are at stake.

title: Be with You
overview: A high school dropout and delinquent, Jie, falls in love with a quiet, speech-impaired high school girl, Guang, leading to a story of mutual growth and healing.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: Insidious: Out of the Further
overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

title: Ice Skater
overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

title: Spa Weekend
overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families and everyday responsibilities, they have forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for what turns out to be an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

title: Born in the Jungle
overview: During late 1950s in Venezuela, nine-year-old Elizabeth’s summer break takes a wild turn when her little brother Leo vanishes into the jungle. She must swap her books for bravery not only to find her brother but also to rescue a mystical furry animal from captivity and bring him back up to the legendary Tepui mountain.

title: Dan Bandung
overview: Basil, a working-studying Fine Arts student, falls in love with Elma after meeting her at a Persib soccer match. He creates a t-shirt featuring her image that goes viral, leading to their acquaintance and eventual dating. However, their relationship faces opposition from Elma's father, forcing Basil to fight for his love amidst various obstacles.

title: Kuncen
overview: Darus (62) is a river guardian. He practices rituals and adheres to beliefs as a form of reciprocity with nature. One day, Darus hears news of a child missing in the river and is asked by the community to help with the search. However, his advancing age and an increasingly toxic relationship with the river have left him unable to go near it, to the point of causing him distress. Darus is trapped in a dilemma: saving the missing child or protecting himself.

title: I'm Game
overview: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

title: Amnesty 1979
overview: In Rome, in June 1979, the International Conference for Amnesty in Brazil is filmed, a major gathering of the Brazilian left in exile. Viewed in the present day, this archive revisits with rare vitality the question of political strategies in the face of state repressive apparatuses.

title: Khalifa
overview: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

title: Don't Politicize
overview: In the northern region of Hungary, the populist propaganda of Orbán’s regime dictates the lives of military high school student Luca and her friends. But how do you distinguish between the opinions imposed on you and your own intrinsic beliefs in the most forming period of your life?

title: We Are All Strangers
overview: A life-altering event forces 21-year-old Junyang and his girlfriend to face reality. At the same time, while Junyang’s father is struggling to hold their modest life together, a woman enters his life and both generations are forced to redefine their family.

title: Red Rue Express
overview: A romantic comedy that modernizes and reimagines one of the most famous and vivid Ukrainian national symbols, Chervona Ruta, and turns it into a new cultural phenomenon.

title: Just Play Dead
overview: When wealthy criminal mastermind Jack Wolfe is cornered by the Feds, he plans to fake his own death and claim the $30 million life insurance payout with his “grieving” wife Nora, while framing her surfer lover Chad for his murder. But Nora is cooking up a scheme of her own: kill Jack for real, frame Chad and keep the fortune for herself. As lies unravel, Nora and Jack scramble to outsmart one another, leaving one burning question: who will come out on top in this twisted game of life and death?

title: A Stroll to Syracuse
overview: In the middle of his life, Paul Gompitz from Rostock makes the decision to travel to Syracuse in Sicily. He is driven to follow in the footsteps of the poet Johann Gottlieb Seume. But: Paul lives in the GDR, behind the most annoying border in the world. His plan is impossible by legal means. So he has to prepare an escape.

title: The Lights, They Fall
overview: Sixteen-year-old Ilay drifts through the summer on the outskirts of Berlin while a palliative nurse accompanies his ailing mother during her last days.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: Explore the extraordinary journey of tennis GOAT Novak Djokovic, who began playing on the hardscrabble courts of Serbia and rose to become the most accomplished champion in the history of men's tennis.

title: Estrelando Marta
overview: Marta dreams of starting her acting career.

title: Ayah, Aku Mau Cerita....
overview: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

title: Harusnya Horror
overview: For the sake of being able to watch the last episode of his favorite anime that appeared exactly before his sudden death, a shy anime-obsessed ghost is forced to accept a task from the afterlife to haunt 100 thousand humans. The problem? He's more terrified of people than they are of him. So, to achieve his goal, he reluctantly becomes the "star talent" for a crew of broke, fraudulent horror creators, which in the end forces him to choose between his personal ambition or saving the only 'family' he has ever found.

title: It Ends
overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

title: Facing El Chapo
overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

title: Soul Trader
overview: A despondent soul arrives in a strange place where he must confront his (mostly) inner demons.

title: Hot Spot
overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

title: Zero Meets Hero
overview: War veteran Mr Thoi and his Gen Z grandson Tri Binh embark on a comedic journey to reunite with old war comrades, weaving together Vietnamese spiritual beliefs and generational bonds.

title: My Armor
overview: A story of April, whose inability to express her grief to her mother leads to a surreal confrontation with a Knight.

title: Billy Knight
overview: After losing his father, Alex discovers a box of unfinished scripts and a handkerchief with the name “Billy Knight” embroidered on it. Consumed with the desire to discover his identity, Alex embarks on a Hollywood adventure to track down this mysterious and reclusive Billy Knight.

title: & Sons
overview: A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, believing he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he tells them a wild and unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past.

title: If I Tell You
overview: IF I TELL YOU uncovers a family’s pressing secret while the 12-year-old son finds his voice and the courage to stand up for what is right.

title: Back to the 90s
overview: Since childhood, five best friends have dreamed of making it big as a boy band. When a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity arises to take a step closer to realizing their musical dream, one band member suddenly wants to give it all up, putting the future of the entire group in jeopardy. The five guys have to rise to the occasion - and in doing so, they suddenly find themselves in a completely different decade.

title: Tokyo MER: Mobile Emergency Room - Capital Crisis
Judaa
overview: Directed by Simerjit SIngh

title: Never Stop Chasing
overview: A documentary portrait of storm chaser Reed Timmer, who was an inspiration for Glen Powell’s character in Twisters.

title: Lau Kumude Hidyo Hero Banna
overview: Lau Kumud Hidyo Hero Banna is an inspiring music video about dreams, friendship, and the journey of becoming a hero. Kumude leaves his home in Dang with big dreams in his heart and travels to Kathmandu to become a hero. On the way, he meets his two close friends who support him and help change his style with black sunglasses, black jeans, a tough jacket, and stylish black Dingo shoes. Looking smart and confident, Kumude walks proudly like a real hero. During the journey, he meets a kind tempo rider girl who supports and encourages him. Their adventure becomes difficult when the tempo tyre gets punctured on the road. Later, a helpful truck driver gives Kumude a ride towards Kathmandu. As they travel through hills, rivers, forests, and beautiful landscapes, Kumude enjoys the beauty of Nepal and learns that becoming a hero needs courage, confidence, friendship, and belief in dreams.

title: i am not from here
overview: A three-headed Melbourne set reality film about art, dilectics, and regionality.

title: May You Have a Good Day
overview: After his father passes away, a man returns to a soon-to-be-demolished Aerotropolis community to sort through unfinished documentary footage and remnants of a life once lived. The fractured bond between father and son remains unresolved. As the roar of airplanes echoes through the emptied neighborhood, his days lose direction. One night, an uninvited spirit that cannot be driven away enters his home.

title: When We Talk About Grape What We Talk About
overview: Late at night, a rideshare driver picks up a passenger and realizes she is his former lover. As the car moves through the city, silence and buried memories surface. In the short ride ahead, they must face what was left unsaid—and the lives they never had together.

title: Scorch Marks
overview: Waking up to a scorched sky, Beckett fears he is the lone survivor of a sudden global catastrophe. Stranded and isolated inside a seaside rental property, his remaining grip on reality rapidly unravels when he is confronted by a terrifying presence—the vengeful spirit of Joel, his abusive ex-husband. To survive both the unfolding global apocalypse and the primordial forces awakening around them, the estranged pair must directly confront the toxic, destructive history of their past life within high society.

title: Finish The Booze
overview: Using photos taken on a dominoes game and one music by the artist Pepe Moreno, the short film is an observational and ironic documentary that shows the transformation of the participants and the chaos that ensues when there is excessive alcohol consumption. A comical and realistic reflection on the excesses and affections that mark the encounters of Brazilian male youth, all to the sound of the electronic forró genre.

title: A Mighty Adventure
overview: Three little insects are transported to a concrete city. A series of extraordinary micro-adventures forces them to explore themselves and helps to build their self-esteem, so they can finally get back home. They become much stronger and happier, are able to choose their own future.

title: Crude Awakenings
overview: At a ruthless PR firm, an ambitious publicist takes on a notorious energy company at the promise of a promotion. As a mysterious sickness spreads throughout her firm, she must decide whether to sacrifice her morals in favour of corporate success.

title: Peppa Pig Perfect Holiday
overview: When Peppa learned that her family wouldn't be going on vacation this year, she was very disappointed. However, a sudden storm transported her to faraway China! Peppa embarked on a wonderful adventure until she was reunited with her family, and Peppa had the perfect vacation ever.

title: Skin of Foam
overview: On a quiet night in the biggest city of Southern China, a small-town migrant carwash worker encounters a strange customer who forces him into a decision that might change his life.

title: Lumíria
overview: In the near future, three young people document the final days of their hometown, knowing they will never see it again.

title: Sutera Di Balik Purnama
overview: Melanie built a wall around her heart after the death of her fiancé, a loss that also shattered her faith in destiny. When her mother passed away and left a will instructing her to manage the traditional kebaya shop on Jonker Street, Melanie accepted it with a rebellious heart. Her plan was simple: destroy the business and walk away from everything.

title: The Last Sunrise
overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

title: 2 Big to Rig
overview: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

title: The Unknown
overview: Photographer David Zimmerman rarely leaves home until friends bring him to a wild party. He becomes fixated on a mysterious woman and follows her. By dawn, his life transforms - he awakens in her body.

title: Ice Cream Man
overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: Coyote vs. Acme
overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
overview: A forbidden exorcism is livestreamed in Indonesia, awakening the legendary female spirit Kuntilanak. What begins as an online spectacle quickly turns deadly. In Taiwan, Mila watches the ritual—and becomes the curse’s first victim. Soon, mysterious deaths and violent possessions follow. When Yulan collapses and is found to have lost part of her soul, it becomes clear that this is not an isolated incident, but a transnational curse. Seeking answers, Mila’s son returns her ashes to Indonesia, hoping to uncover the truth behind her death. Instead, he steps into a nightmare rooted in ancient folklore and unresolved hatred. As supernatural violence escalates, the group realizes that once Kuntilanak is summoned, the curse will not stop—until it claims everything in its path.

title: The Dog Stars
overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

title: Idiots
overview: When two unqualified bozos are hired to transfer a rich teen to rehab, their straightforward gig quickly spirals into dangerous mayhem.

title: Austerity
overview: Mona is a young woman and bookworm with no formal education, living in the social housing project Nøjsomheden in Helsingør. She falls head over heels in love with Nikolaj, who comes from a more well-off neighborhood on the other side of town. Meanwhile, she is also desperately trying to get her pusher cousin Frederik to realize that he must visit his dying mother, Mona's beloved and all-embracing Aunt Tut. Will Mona succeed in getting Frederik to reconcile with his mother - and how? Can she match the intellectual Nikolaj - or is the class gap too great?

title: Chelot
overview: The story follows Haqqim, a special operations police officer, who is forced to become an informant for a crime syndicate to overcome financial pressure and save his family. This desperate act puts himself and his loved ones in danger.

title: Muito Prazer
overview: Rubem, a rideshare driver with no prospects, receives as inheritance the Pérola Motel, which he soon discovers is a dilapidated building. There, he meets Grace, a former employee who had stayed on living in one of the suites after the motel closed. Unable to sell the property and mired in debt, Grace and Rubem join forces to reopen the motel. Almost as a lark and with the help of Nalva, an internet whiz, they begin recording their guests and, to make some extra cash, selling the videos with identities masked to erotic websites. The scheme quickly becomes both lucrative and dangerous.

title: Rumah Singgah
overview: Karla, a talented young runner diagnosed with bone cancer, receives treatment at a halfway house. There, she learns to accept reality through the support of the residents and bu Andin, while together they realize their ultimate dream.

title: Prosecution
overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

title: A Delivery from Hell
overview: A package arrives at their doorsteps. There is no sender's name. No explanation as to why it was delivered to them. But the moment they open it, their lives spiral into a nightmare. One by one, lives are put on the line. Now, the question is no longer how to avoid the package, but how to escape the curse once they have received it.

title: Hive
overview: A strict, anxious teenager loses the child she’s babysitting and must brave a sinister force hiding in plain sight among the children in the playground. As her world unravels and her grip on reality starts to slip, she must outwit a world where nothing is as it seems to make it out alive.

title: The Chilean
overview: 1976, Aldo, an explosives expert, is exiled to Italy after mining protests. There he meets Luciana, an anarchist doctor who offers to reunite him with his family, but only if he takes up his old trade: making bombs for revolutionaries.

title: Our Secret
overview: A Black Brazilian family in the city of Belo Horizonte, tries to rebuild their home after a recent loss. Caught between memories and nightmares, and unable to express what they feel to each other, a mother and her children shield themselves from the pain of grief through their individual routines. Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Finally, confronted with the truth, they face the deep roots of their grief and come together to traverse this moment with love and courage.

title: MYXOMATOSIS
overview: Harlen’s a young  girl who curiously follows a pair of pink hands through a mirror.  She becomes part of a beautiful world where absolutely everything is controlled by The ominous Man with The Bunnyhead.

title: Operasi Pesta Copet
overview: In a desperate act to get quick money, Ijal and friends embark on a high-stakes operation: pickpocketing at Indonesia's biggest music festival, Pestapora.

title: Moonzy: The Dark Side of the Moon
overview: Luntik, Kuzya and Vupsen and Pupsen build a spacecraft to find Luntik's missing dad and encounter adventures in the search.

title: Pa Pa Go
overview: Influencer Bunny struggles to stand out online when her ex-gangster father, Tian, is released from prison. Their reunion sparks conflict as he’s urged to rejoin the triad while she defends her career. Tian’s accidental viral fame fuels jealousy from his ambitious underling, triggering gang turmoil and exposing Bunny’s family ties. As her public image collapses, father and daughter must confront their past and choose between power, pride, and love—learning that redemption and understanding are the only way to truly move forward.

title: Buyer Beware
overview: A hilarious new horror story by upcoming director ‘Tommy Linguey’ - Coming Soon

title: Suffocation
overview: In an elite high school swimming team plagued by a sinister curse, five teens unwittingly unleash a chain of deadly events after exposing a forbidden teacher-student affair through a leaked video. As the curse reawakens, they must confront betrayal and despair while racing to uncover the truth and break the cycle of death, only to realize they are destined to become each other’s undoing.

title: Trial of Hein
overview: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

title: Nem Tudo é Paz e Amor
Marco Bellocchio - La porta della realtà
overview: After 20 years of working with Marco Bellocchio, a close collaborator feels the need to share what he experienced with him.

title: Abode of Dawn
overview: In the middle of the Siberian Taiga, cut off from the outside world, a community of men and women has lived for three decades, led by the man they consider their guide: Vissarion, the self-proclaimed messiah.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

title: Buddy
overview: Remember BUDDY—the bright orange unicorn and star of that classic childrens' television show who brought joy and life lessons into your living room?  Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

title: The Ghost and The Gun
overview: In 1948 Malaya, WWII vets Iz and Abe face vengeful ex-ally Chin Liu, who betrayed them during the war and now leads terrorists to their village. Haunted by past trauma, Iz must confront both his demons and Chin Liu's deadly advance.

title: Secret File
overview: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.

title: My Playground
overview: Trapped in Dubai where riding is “not allowed,” a young BMX rider hits the road on a worldwide adventure to find  epic spots, a real community — and himself.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: Dead End
overview: Located in a futuristic Dhaka City from the 2100s. We follow Zayn Khan our protagonist, a genius engineer trying to fulfill his father's dream. However, he gets intertwined with a street racing gang named 'The Hawks', lead by Alvan Haque.

title: Beyond Belief
overview: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

title: Romin
overview: When Romin discovers a lost object in the forest, he asks his friends to help him uncover the legend behind this mysterious object, while a grieving man seeks to use the artifact to bring his wife back.

title: The Last Temptation of Becky
overview: Working as a CIA field agent, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf’s Lair, Hitler’s WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

title: The Sun Never Sets
overview: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

title: wabi_
overview: Trapped in his nostalgia and haunted by the impermanence of things, a sad little ghost is unable to pass through the liminal space he occupies.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: The White Dragon, Erik Reed, has returned home to Virtuo City 3 years later after being defeated in a colossal battle against the ancient overlord, Ashtagor. The crystal he used to become the White Dragon was broken in two as a result of the epic battle, both pieces were subsequently lost. Being blamed for the destruction and collateral lives lost, his identity was outed after the battle thus making him a fugitive from the law. We now follow Erik on his journey as he teams up with treasure hunters from the past who help him reclaim his power as the White Dragon. Once reunited with his powers, he and his team are now ready to battle a new threat, Dragon Prime, who seeks revenge against the White Dragon. Erik must now try and defeat Dragon Prime in order to get one step closer to clearing his name and being able to protect his family from an ancient evil that still lurks in the darkness… Ashtagor

title: Castration Movie Chapter iii.ii Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage
overview: Izzy does everything in her power to stop her partner from transitioning.

title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Retribution
overview: Tate (Craig Fairbrass) battles ruthless mercenaries throughout Ibiza as he avenges his friend's death.  Get ready for the biggest and most action packed film in the successful independent crime saga.

title: Parbati
overview: Autism is not a weakness or a flaw, it is simply a different way of experiencing the world. Every person learns, thinks, feels, communicates, and understands life in their own unique way. This story follows the emotional journey of a brother and sister whose deep bond becomes the heart of the film. Amid society’s misunderstandings and everyday struggles, their relationship reflects love, acceptance, sacrifice, and the strength of family, creating a touching and inspiring tale about embracing individuality.

title: Flaggan
overview: On election night 2010, two young Sweden Democrats — the charming but unserious Ville and his cousin Tobias — are given the task of hanging a huge Swedish flag in Rinkeby square, but end up drawn into a chaotic night full of crazy encounters with drug dealers, activists, and Finnish bikers.

title: The Brightest Sun
overview: When a private detective is murdered, a former colleague and a trainee detective are sent to investigate. Along the way, they uncover a tragic truth that triggers memories from their own haunted pasts.

title: The Parking Spot
overview: From the philosophy lectern to the director’s chair, Louis Godbout draws on fifteen years of profound contemplation to depict an ordinary "battle": fighting over a parking space. It all begins with one parking spot, a couple and a stranger. Calling the police fails to end the conflict, which instead escalates into a silent psychological warfare. A single comment from the stranger acts like a domino effect, knocking down every seemingly solid pillar of the couple’s relationship. Undercurrents run rampant throughout the night.The film employs tranquil empty shots to create an oppressive, suffocating atmosphere, and its understated dialogue leaves vast room for the audience to interpret. When intimate bonds meet the game of human nature, who is the real stranger in the end?

title: Masterni
overview: A girl goes missing, leaving the nation in shock as every lead goes cold.

title: Barreda
overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger Film Concert in Cinema
overview: A recording of the Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger Film Concert, which was held in May 2025. Experience the show's iconic score and the final battle with live orchestral music performed by the Grand Philharmonic TOKYO!

title: Baggo
overview: Directed by Baljit Singh Deo

title: Ebre / Trarza
overview: This short documentary addresses the global issue of climate change, highlighting its unequal impacts on rural communities in deltaic regions of both the Global South and North. While the Global North is a major contributor to climate change, its devastating effects are most felt in the Global South, particularly in regions like Trarza, Mauritania, where agriculture is severely impacted. Similarly, the Terres de l’Ebre in Catalonia faces rising sea levels and land erosion, threatening local livelihoods. These shared challenges provide a rich opportunity for youth from both regions to engage in dialogue and storytelling.

title: The Invisibles
overview: The story follows a family of five, living quietly and away from prying eyes on the Izu Islands—including the youngest daughter, born invisible. Their mother, who had raised her cheerfully, has passed away from illness, and their anxious father has devoted himself to hiding his daughters from the world. One day, however, they must set out on a journey to visit their grandmother, a famous actress living in Tokyo.

title: Electric Meat
overview: A photographer spirals into madness when a murdered model he's adopted as his new muse decides she doesn't want to stay dead.

title: Last Night I Conquered the City of Thebes
overview: On a cold winter afternoon, António and Jota return from the front with their friends, looking for an ancient Roman thermal bath. They joke with each other while wading through swamps, recounting past tactical glories. The baths have appeared after a long time spent under the water of a reservoir, and people of all ages curious about the discovery come to spend the day. But there is something mysterious about these thermal waters - as if the baths influence the mood of the men, giving them the courage to say things they have never told anyone. As day turns to night, they confess their feelings and their fears of losing their best friend forever.

title: Your's Sincerely RAAM
overview: Upcoming Kannada Film

title: The Pickleball Racket
overview: Disgraced councilwoman of Busterville, Ethel Wilton, finds herself at the center of a pickleball conspiracy. She decides the only way to save her city is to stop the citywide pickleball tournament with the help of her unlikely friends.

title: Lives at Right Angles
overview: Daiki has autism spectrum disorder, and his sister Nozomi has supported him since childhood. Having lost their mother at a young age, the siblings distanced themselves from their neglectful father and have lived their lives diligently together

title: LEATHERBACK
overview: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

title: Michael Jackson: A Life in Music
overview: The legendary journey of Michael Jackson, from his early days with the Jackson 5 to his breakthrough albums and live concerts.

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Her Baby Didn't Block Her Jump Shot
overview: In 1969, high school freshman Jane led her basketball team to a state tournament. In 1970, she scored over 40 points a game. In 1971, when she gives birth, state rules make her ineligible to play. In 1972, with the backing of her coach and friends, she continued to play and began a landmark challenge to a rule that allowed boys involved in a pregnancy to continue playing while refusing the same privilege to girls.

title: The Robot Chicken [adult swim] 25th Anniversary Special
overview: Follows iconic Adult Swim characters on a cruise ship celebrating the network's 25th anniversary. The cruise turns into a disaster, potentially spelling a watery doom for all aboard.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Alien Heart
overview: Miles and Ravi house sit a NASA exobiologist mansion, while running astronomy club sign ups, they discover a runaway alien on a ticking cosmic clock, bullies, and crushes that turn their summer into chaos and adventure.
